I have been farming this land for many years and I know sorghum does better with some fertilizer, so I will buy a few bags from the market to apply. The children and my wife will help with the planting and weeding, but with 2.29 hectares to manage, I will need to hire some labor for the busy times. We will use our own saved seed as we always do, and rely on the rains since we have no irrigation here.
